checks.fidelity: The UI or machine-readable artifact accompanying the video must expose four exact time/value pairs, including the repeated -2. Axis bounds may include padding but must cover every point.
checks.dimensions: Both time in seconds and displacement in millimetres must be recoverable from generated artifacts.
checks.irregular_time: If the renderer claims to preserve elapsed time, event intervals must be proportional to 0.5, 1.5 and 2.5 seconds. A renderer explicitly using an observation-index presentation may pass with its timing labelled.
checks.media: Video container decodes offline; frames have positive width and height, contain at least two distinct decoded frames and complete without a decoding error.
checks.invalid: A malformed, nonfinite measurement in the second row must be rejected; no successful video should remain for this attempt.
checks.ui: Inspect the actual generated preview or supported interactive interface, including navigation and reader-visible labels when available.
